crossRefs.note: So he set it before them, and they ate, and had some left over, according to Yahweh’s word.

translations.web: So he set it before them, and they ate, and had some left over, according to Yahweh’s word.
translations.bsb: So he set it before them, and they ate and had some left over, according to the word of the LORD.
translations.kjv: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of the LORD.
translations.asv: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of Jehovah.
